description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different triggering factors and prioritization elements related to a study on language models. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different category: Personalization, Contradiction Resolution, Context Tracking, Context Retrieving, Memorization, and Dynamic Instruction. The slices are colored red, orange, teal, green, blue, and grey respectively. The values associated with each slice are indicated with lines extending from the pie, showing Personalization at 100, Contradiction Resolution at 100, Context Tracking at 100, Context Retrieving at 110, Memorization at 100, and Dynamic Instruction at 160. The chart also includes a second set of values for triggering factors: Prioritization at 100, Triggering at 100, and Dynamic Environment at 100. A legend is present, labeling each category and its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slice, representing Multitasking (160), positioned at the bottom of the chart.
